integrations-faq.name: Integrations & packaging FAQ
integrations-faq.content:
# Integrations and packaging FAQ

Owner: Priyanka Rao (SE). For AEs and BDRs. If your question is answered here, don't ping #se-requests. Last updated: Oct 30, 2026.

## Packaging

1. **Do we price per site or per user?** Per site (dock scheduling, by door band) plus named users included per site (10 per site; extra users $15 per user per month). Carrier portal access is unlimited carriers at no extra cost.
2. **Can the yard module be sold on its own?** Yes, since Oct 1: "Yard Standalone" SKU, priced per trailer spot: $4.50 per spot per month, minimum 200 spots, includes gate check-in on tablets and the yard map. No dock scheduling needed. Quote it through deal desk like any other SKU.
3. **Is SSO included?** SAML SSO is included on every mid-market plan. SCIM is Enterprise only.
4. **Setup fees?** Implementation is $3,000 per site, waived on 3-year terms and on single-site deals under $20k.

## Integrations

5. **Standard WMS connectors** (appointment sync both ways): Korvex WMS, Lattice WMS, Stonepath, OpenDock WMS. Typical setup: 1 to 2 weeks.
6. **TMS connectors**: Routewise TMS, Freightlane, Haulbase. For any other TMS: inbound and outbound webhooks or nightly CSV over SFTP. Small TMS vendors usually take 2 to 3 weeks via webhooks.
7. **Homegrown WMS/TMS**: REST API (OpenAPI spec at docs.corvana.example/api). Typical integration effort on the customer side is 3 to 4 weeks with one developer; we provide a sandbox tenant and a Postman collection.
8. **ERP**: no direct ERP connectors; go through the WMS.

## Security

9. SOC 2 Type II (report period Apr 2025 to Mar 2026) and the latest pen test executive summary are in the trust profile. The full pen test report requires an NDA and goes through the TrustGate vault.
10. Data retention after termination: 90 days by default, 60 days with certified deletion available as a contract term (Lena has the clause).
11. AI: customer data is not used to train or fine-tune models. Approved wording is in the trust profile.

## Requests that do need an SE

- Custom demo data or a tailored demo
- Security questionnaires (start them the day you get them)
- Integration scoping calls with customer IT

bluegate-rider.name: Bluegate - security conditions rider (Lena)
bluegate-rider.content:
# Bluegate Cold Storage: security conditions rider

Prepared by Lena Fischer, Commercial Counsel, Nov 5. To be attached to MSA v2026.2 and referenced in the order form under "Special terms". This wording matches what Hannah Sorensen (Bluegate IT Security) approved on Nov 3.

## 1. Certified deletion of customer data

Within sixty (60) days after the effective date of termination or expiration of the Agreement, Corvana will delete all Customer Data from its production systems and backups, and will provide Customer with a written certificate of deletion signed by an officer of Corvana within ten (10) business days after deletion is complete. Customer may request an export of Customer Data in CSV format at any time before deletion.

## 2. Subprocessor change notification

Corvana will notify Customer in writing at least seventy-two (72) hours before any new subprocessor begins processing Customer Data, or any existing subprocessor's processing of Customer Data materially changes. Customer may object in writing within thirty (30) days of the notice. If the parties cannot resolve the objection in good faith, Customer may terminate the affected services without penalty.

## 3. AI use

Corvana will not use Customer Data to train or fine-tune machine learning models. (Same wording as the questionnaire answer, AI addendum Q4.)

## Notes for Tessa

- Do not change the numbers above. Hannah approved exactly 60 days and 72 hours, and any change sends it back to her security review.
- Order form: put "Special terms: per Security Conditions Rider dated Nov 5, 2026" and attach this rider. Do not paraphrase it in the order form.
- Ken asked about holding price for a 3-year term. That's a deal desk question, not legal; the rider works for any term length.

handoff-process.name: Closed-won to CS handoff process
handoff-process.content:
# Closed-won to Customer Success handoff

Owner: Derek Hollins. Applies to every new logo, any size. Adopted Sep 1 after two customers waited three weeks to hear from anyone.

## Within 1 business day of signature

1. Mark the opportunity Closed Won in Stratus with the signed order form attached.
2. Post the win in #deals.
3. Email cs-handoffs@corvana.example with the customer name and signed date. CS assigns a CSM within 1 business day.

## Within 2 business days of signature

4. Create a handoff task in Macro (template: "Handoff: <customer>") assigned to yourself, with:
   - Customer contacts: signer, day-to-day owner, IT contact, AP contact
   - What they bought (sites, users, modules, term, start date)
   - Why they bought, and the success metric they agreed to
   - Anything promised during the sale (training, hardware, integrations, dates)
   - Carrier communication plan (who tells their carriers, and when)
5. Hold a 30-minute handoff call with the customer and the CSM. Write notes in a handoff doc.

## Small deals (under $25k)

Same steps. Small customers churn faster when onboarding is slow. Make sure the CSM knows about any training request: CS has recorded training videos for gate check-in, the dock board and the carrier portal that can go out the same day.

## Tablet hardware

Customers provide their own tablets (iPad 9th gen or newer, or Android 12+). CS sends the hardware checklist at kickoff.

## Checklist

- [ ] Closed Won in Stratus
- [ ] Win posted
- [ ] cs-handoffs email
- [ ] Handoff task created
- [ ] Handoff call held
